name: crates.io proxy
description: Caching proxy for the crates.io registry.
about: Caches the crates.io sparse index and crate downloads on Linux x86-64. Each Cargo client needs source replacement configured with sparse+<proxy URL>/index/. Serves HTTP without authentication.

variables.label: Cache folder
variables.description: Folder for cached index entries and crate files, writable by UID 777.

variables.label: Proxy URL
variables.description: URL Cargo clients use to reach the proxy, including the host port.

variables.label: Index cache lifetime (seconds)
variables.description: Seconds before a cached index entry expires.
